#!/bin/bash

# Backup Script for Markdown Files
# This script copies all .md files from the current directory to a backup directory

# Define source and backup directories
SOURCE_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace"
BACKUP_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace/backup"

# Create backup directory if it doesn't exist
echo "Creating backup directory if it doesn't exist..."
mkdir -p "$BACKUP_DIR"

# Copy all .md files from source to backup directory
echo "Copying .md files to backup directory..."
cp "$SOURCE_DIR"/*.md "$BACKUP_DIR/" 2>/dev/null

# Check if any files were copied
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Backup completed successfully!"
    echo "Files backed up to: $BACKUP_DIR"
else
    echo "No .md files found to backup."
fi

# List backed up files
echo "Contents of backup directory:"
ls -la "$BACKUP_DIR"
